newsitem.title: UK: Burmah Castrol to sell adhesives unit.
newsitem.headline: Burmah Castrol to sell adhesives unit.

text.p: British lubricants firm Burmah Castrol Plc said on Wednesday it planned to sell the adhesives division of Burmah Castrol Chemicals.
Burmah said it was likely to sell separately the two companies that make up the adhesives division, Industrial Adhesives in Britain and Columbia Cement in the U.S.
The division had 1996 turnover of about 40 million stg.
Burmah said the disposal formed part of its plan to focus on its four main businesses -- Foundry, Steelmills, Construction and Screen Printing Inks.
"Further disposals of certain non-strategic units are planned," the company said in a statement.
Burmah also said it planned to spend a total of about 50 million stg on several acquisitions in its core businesses in the near future.
